nvitk.viz.pet_hotspots
======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.viz.pet_hotspots

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   suv SUV hotspot visualization (3D).

   The main entry point is :func:`show_suv_hotspots_3d`, which renders:

   - A segmentation ROI (binary or multi-label) as a translucent surface.
   - The highest SUV voxels *inside* that ROI as colored points ("hotspots").

   .. rubric:: Example

   ```python
   from nvitk.io import imread
   from nvitk.viz import show_suv_hotspots_3d

   suv = imread("/path/PT_SUV.nii.gz", axes="XYZ")        # already SUV
   mask = imread("/path/FAT.nii.gz", axes="XYZ")          # labels or binary

   show_suv_hotspots_3d(
       suv,
       mask,
       label_ids=(1,),          # e.g. visceral fat label
       hotspot="top_percent",
       top_percent=0.1,         # top 0.1% SUVs inside ROI
       max_points=20000,
   )
   ```

   Quick CLI smoke test
   --------------------

   ```bash
   python -c 'from nvitk.io import imread; from nvitk.viz import show_suv_hotspots_3d; suv=imread("PT_SUV.nii.gz", axes="XYZ"); m=imread("MASK.nii.gz", axes="XYZ"); show_suv_hotspots_3d(suv, m, hotspot="top_percent", top_percent=0.1, max_points=20000)'
   ```

Module Contents

.. py:data:: HotspotMode

.. py:function:: show_hotspots(suv: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, mask: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, *, label_ids: Sequence[int] | None = None, hotspot: HotspotMode = 'top_percent', top_percent: float = 0.1, top_k: int | None = None, threshold: float | None = None, max_points: int = 50000, mask_iso: float = 0.5, mask_opacity: float = 0.25, mask_smooth: bool = False, point_size: float = 6.0, cmap: str = 'turbo', notebook: bool = False, show: bool = True, title: str | None = None, auto_threshold_fallback: bool = True, allow_empty_hotspot: bool = False, scalar_bar_title: str = 'SUV', show_min_max_text: bool = True, show_orientation_axes: bool = True) -> Any

   Render SUV hotspots inside a segmentation mask.

   :param suv: suv in **SUV units**, 3D. Either :class:`~nvitk.types.Image` or a NumPy array.
   :param mask: Segmentation mask, 3D, same grid as *suv*. Binary or multi-label.
   :param label_ids: Optional subset of labels (for multi-label masks). None means "all nonzero".
   :param hotspot: Hotspot selection mode.
   :param top_percent: For ``hotspot='top_percent'``: keep voxels within the top *top_percent* SUVs inside ROI.
                       Example: ``0.1`` means top 0.1% (very sparse hotspots).
   :param top_k: For ``hotspot='top_k'``: keep the top K voxels by SUV inside ROI.
   :param suv_threshold: For ``hotspot='threshold'``: keep voxels with SUV >= this value inside ROI.
   :param max_points: Cap number of rendered hotspot voxels (largest SUVs retained).
   :param mask_iso: Isosurface threshold for the ROI volume (binary ROI -> 0.5 is typical).
   :param mask_opacity: ROI surface opacity.
   :param mask_smooth: If True, apply light smoothing to the ROI surface mesh.
   :param point_size: Hotspot point size (rendered as spheres).
   :param cmap: Colormap for SUV scalars.
   :param notebook: If True, configure PyVista plotter for notebooks.
   :param show: If True, immediately show the interactive window.
   :param title: Optional plot title.
   :param auto_threshold_fallback: If True (default), when the first hotspot selection is empty but the ROI is
                                   non-empty, retry once with ``hotspot='threshold'`` and ``threshold=0.1``.
   :param allow_empty_hotspot: If True, when hotspots are still empty after any fallback, return a plotter
                               showing only the ROI surface with a note (for batch HTML reports). If False
                               (default), raise :class:`~nvitk.core.exceptions.ValidationError`.

   :returns: A PyVista plotter instance.
   :rtype: plotter
